methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $15M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 13 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 20.4x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
fab2 is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Jim Keller and Sam Zeloof, having raised $15M+. The peer universe includes 3 public semiconductors comps (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private-stage peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector, though only 1 valuation method produced reliable output.

Stage-Progression methodology applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $15M total raised proxy, implying a valuation of $38M. Peer-Median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables—only 2 adjacent-stage peers exist in the narrow set, below the 3-datapoint threshold. Public-Comp Anchoring could not be applied because target revenue is not available; while the Semiconductors public median trades at 20.4x P/S across the three comps, private fab-stage companies typically do not disclose revenue.

Given the single applicable method, the triangulated range is $32M to $43M, with a median of $38M. The narrowness of this range reflects methodological constraints rather than valuation precision. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific founder profile and market window, and the absence of revenue-based anchoring. Any revised valuation should incorporate disclosed traction metrics or updated fundraising terms.
